source.paraphrase: Tiny initial risk in fresh trigger entries distorts R-based summaries.

hypothesis: Tiny initial risk in fresh trigger entries distorts R-based summaries.
rule_delta: Compare one preregistered alternative: minimum risk of 0.1 daily ATR OR an explicitly defined 34 EMA stop, using a new strategy version. Choose before evaluation.
rationale: No floor or stop change is active; evaluate ATR units as well as R.

source.paraphrase: Late/gap trigger performance may reflect a post-hoc cohort selection.

hypothesis: Late/gap trigger performance may reflect a post-hoc cohort selection.
rule_delta: Test whether a separately named gap-and-go policy adds prospective session-level value compared with retaining all baseline trigger events.
rationale: Do not select the cohort because it was best in the development sample.

source.paraphrase: Extended-session 13/48 EMA conviction may improve parity with the source indicator.

hypothesis: Extended-session 13/48 EMA conviction may improve parity with the source indicator.
rule_delta: Create a separately versioned ETH-13/48 variant with a defined extended-hours warm-up and otherwise frozen rules.
rationale: Parity is a correctness/source question; a return improvement needs its own test.

source.paraphrase: Post-hoc reward/risk bucket boundaries may miscalibrate target forecasts.

hypothesis: Post-hoc reward/risk bucket boundaries may miscalibrate target forecasts.
rule_delta: Compare one frozen target-specific regularized log(R) model against a declared descriptive/baseline model on untouched chronological data.
rationale: Do not reuse supplied exploratory folds as an untouched test.

source.paraphrase: Longer high-quality history may improve evaluation coverage and source stability.

hypothesis: Longer high-quality history may improve evaluation coverage and source stability.
rule_delta: Audit a candidate historical feed for timestamp, session, adjustment and bar parity before retraining any statistics.
rationale: A paid data source is a data-quality research decision, not an automatic strategy upgrade.

source.paraphrase: Freezing the baseline can establish a clean prospective observation record.

hypothesis: Freezing the baseline can establish a clean prospective observation record.
rule_delta: Keep saty-sig-2.0 unchanged; first conduct a 20-session observation audit, then register GG and stress-grid experiments on future data.
rationale: Twenty sessions are an initial operational review; promotion still requires the stricter registered evidence gates.
